purpose: Classify every webapp top-level entry under the implemented source and copyable-distribution architecture.
maintainerLayout: all source-only paths remain outside template; a dedicated maintainer directory is not required
requiredSeparationRules: The branch root remains the template-development source artifact.
The contents of template are copied byte-for-byte to a product repository root.
No required reference below template may escape template.
Publication integration and source-only conformance fixtures remain outside template.
All implementation, release-evidence, and release-bundle clean-room stages start from template rather than the complete branch root.
